geeklist.title: US Only - Cleaning Up Auction
geeklist.description:
This is a US-only auction. Details are as follows:
1) Please bid in $1 increments. 2) This Auction will end on Saturday Evening (EST), 15th Nov 2025, at a random time 3) I will be shipping from VA 24060 and the Winner pays the shipping cost and associated fees. If you prefer local pickup, that can be done as well. 4) I will be using Pirateship and will combine shipping if you win multiple games 5) Payment can be made using - Paypal, Venmo or Zelle. BGG will get its 3% 6) Every game has a starting bid (SB) and a Buy It Now (BIN) option. 7) I've mention small description of the games and included images for reference. These are game that I've never played or played once. 8) I reserve the right to end auction items with or without bids (excluding BIN) if I receive a buy it now type offer elsewhere (marketplace, geekmail, crossposted local listings, etc). 9) All games for sale come from a pet free and smoke free home.
Feel free to contact me on geekmail to get more info or if you interested to offer a bundle deal for multiple games.
geeklist.comment: Yes, I can do local pickup
